items.q: Is GoHighLevel's AI Employee Unlimited plan really unlimited?
items.a:
Not entirely. AI Employee Unlimited, at $97 per sub-account a month, removes the monthly caps on Conversation AI, Voice AI, Reviews AI and Content AI, but HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article attaches a fair-use policy to it: if usage is excessive, abusive or degrades platform performance, HighLevel says it may throttle or limit the service, require an upgrade, or end access, with or without notice.

Several things also sit outside the plan. Agent Studio stays pay-per-use on every plan, Ask AI and AI Studio come with 3 times the Growth plan's allowance per 5-hour window rather than no limit, and Managed Agents get 1,000 runs a month. Phone System charges still apply to every call a voice agent makes or takes, and texts are billed separately. Treat Unlimited as a flat fee for the AI itself, not for the communications around it.

items.q: What happens when a GoHighLevel sub-account goes over its AI Employee Growth allowance?
items.a:
It depends on one setting. GoHighLevel's AI Employee Growth plan costs $50 per sub-account a month and includes 1,000 Conversation AI responses and 100 Voice AI minutes, and HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article says the sub-account's AI usage limit setting decides what happens after that. With “Keep AI running, just notify” selected, or with spending limits disabled, the AI keeps working and the extra usage is billed at pay-per-use rates, such as $1.25 per million GPT-5 input tokens for chat and $0.045 a minute for the Voice Engine before text-to-speech, token and phone charges. With “Block AI at the limit” selected, the AI stops when the limit is reached.

Blocking protects the wallet, but the AI stops answering; keeping it running keeps the AI answering at a cost that rises with use. Check which setting each client's sub-account uses before a busy month.

items.q: Do GoHighLevel Voice AI calls also use phone minutes?
items.a:
Yes. HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article says Phone System charges still apply to all phone calls regardless of plan, and its glossary says they apply even when inbound Voice AI is covered by AI Employee Unlimited. Each GoHighLevel voice agent call therefore carries two charges: the AI part, which is covered by Unlimited, by the first 100 minutes on Growth, or billed per minute plus tokens on pay-per-use, and the phone part, which comes out of the wallet on every plan.

HighLevel's Phone System guide lists US and Canada calls at $0.0166 a minute outbound and $0.01165 a minute for inbound calls answered in the web or mobile app or on a desk phone, billed in whole minutes with any partial minute rounded up, and each local number costs $1.15 a month. The AI article does not break down which phone line items an AI-handled call triggers, so read the wallet's transaction detail after the agent's first week.

items.q: How much does a GoHighLevel Conversation AI conversation cost?
items.a:
On pay-per-use there is no fixed price, because GoHighLevel bills Conversation AI by tokens and the token count differs from one conversation to the next. GPT-5 costs $1.25 per million input tokens, which cover the customer's messages, the conversation history, the agent's instructions, contact details and knowledge-base content, and $10.00 per million output tokens for the replies it writes.

HighLevel's own worked example, a conversation using 100,000 input tokens and 25,000 output tokens at GPT-5's rates, costs $0.375. More back-and-forth, longer replies and a bigger knowledge base push the figure up, and switching to GPT-5 Mini, priced at a fifth of GPT-5's rates, pulls it down. A sub-account on AI Employee Growth gets its first 1,000 agent responses each month within the plan instead, and AI Employee Unlimited has no monthly cap, subject to fair use.

items.q: Does GoHighLevel charge for every AI review reply?
items.a:
Only for AI-assisted replies that are actually sent. Without an AI Employee plan, GoHighLevel's Reviews AI costs $0.01 per sent reply that uses an AI suggestion, and HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article lists what is not charged: generating up to 4 reply suggestions for a review, sending a suggestion you have substantially rewritten, which counts as a manual reply, and retrying or resending the same reply. Auto-Pilot and Drip Mode are billed once for each AI reply they send.

Both AI Employee plans include Reviews AI without a monthly cap, under fair use. At a cent a reply, a business would have to send 5,000 AI-assisted replies in a month before pay-per-use cost as much as the $50 Growth plan, so review replies on their own are rarely a reason to buy a plan.

items.q: Can an agency pass GoHighLevel AI costs on to its clients?
items.a:
It depends on the platform plan. GoHighLevel's Starter plan, at $97 a month, cannot rebill any usage to sub-accounts, so the agency's wallet pays every AI charge and the agency can only recover it through its own client fees. HighLevel's rebilling article says at-cost rebilling unlocks on the $297 Unlimited and $497 Agency Pro plans and names AI among the usage it covers, but the AI Product Pricing article adds that rebilling AI Employee usage requires the $497 plan, and only Agency Pro can add a markup. Either way, HighLevel charges the agency's wallet first; rebilling then charges the client.

To see what each client used, agency admins can open the AI Suite, which breaks AI spend, token use and pay-per-use charges down by sub-account. HighLevel also tells agencies to confirm current in-app pricing and billing settings before quoting AI prices to a client, since model and provider rates can change.

items.q: Is the AI Employee included in any GoHighLevel plan?
items.a:
No. None of GoHighLevel's three published plans includes it: AI Employee is an optional add-on priced per sub-account, Growth at $50 a month and Unlimited at $97 a month, on top of Starter, Unlimited or Agency Pro. The names overlap, so read them carefully. The $297 Unlimited platform plan gives an agency unlimited sub-accounts but does not put any of them on AI Employee Unlimited, and HighLevel's billing FAQ notes that AI Employee shares its $97 price with an agency plan, so agencies should check invoices and wallet transactions to identify each charge.

A sub-account without either AI plan is not cut off from AI; it pays per use instead. Some AI tools carry no extra charge in any case: HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article lists Funnel AI, Email AI, the knowledge base and Workflow AI's builder as included, subject to fair use.
